description: Search everything in a workspace (projects, actors, checklists, interviews, automations, issues, goals, feedback, knowledge, insights, design reviews, resources, conversations) by name or content. Use it instead of listing and filtering, and before creating something that may already exist. Results carry the id for the matching getter. Omit `query` to browse recent items.

project_id.description: Project UUID, from list_projects, to restrict results to one project. Workspace-level entities (actors, actor knowledge, conversations) are excluded when this is set, since they do not belong to a project. Omit to search the whole workspace.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "checkout" or "onboard". Words are matched as prefixes, so a partial term is fine (max 200 characters). Leave empty to list the most recently updated items.

types.description: Restrict the search to these entity types, e.g. ["checklist", "interview"]. Defaults to all of them.

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: search

results.description: Ranked by relevance, or most recently updated first when query is empty.

id.description: The entity id to pass to its getter (get_checklist, get_actor, ...).

parent_id.description: The actor id for actor knowledge and conversations; null otherwise.

snippet.description: Matching text, when the match was in the body.

type.description: Entity type, e.g. checklist or interview. Picks the getter to call next.

title: Search workspace
